h1: YOUR AWARD-WINNING ONE-STOP SHOP FOR OUTDOOR POWER EQUIPMENT & FIREPLACES IN WELLINGTON
about:
INDOOR WOOD FIRES

We have Wellington's largest range of indoor wood burners and fireplaces across our three stores, featuring leading wood fire brands including Metro, Firenzo, Pyro, and Woodsman, along with a wide range of parts and accessories to keep your fire performing at its best for years to come. Whether you're looking for a traditional wood-burning fireplace or a modern wood burner, our knowledgeable team can help you choose the right heating solution for your home. As experienced wood burner specialists, we work closely with trusted installation partners to make the process easy for you. They can take care of the council consent process as well as the physical installation, so you’ll be relaxing in front of your beautiful new fire in no time. We stock many of our most popular models in-store, but if there's a particular wood burner or fireplace you're interested in that isn't on display, simply get in touch.
